Drop both sidecars (unlink `db/brain.sqlite-wal` and `-shm`, ideally with the DB closed / no live connections) after moving the full old file set aside and copying the main file in — never leave the old `-wal` beside the new DB. Skipping it lets SQLite find a WAL whose header salts still chain, so it replays stale frames over the restored image: resurrected/moved-aside rows, page-level corruption, or `database disk image is malformed` despite the sha256 check passing.

Repo already encodes this: `backup.py` `DB_SIDECARS`/`DB_FILES` and `_drop_stale_sidecars` (lines 58-62, 626-629).
